Package com.datastax.oss.driver.api.querybuilder.update

Interface UpdateStart

  • All Superinterfaces:
    OngoingAssignment
    public interface UpdateStart
extends OngoingAssignment
    The beginning of an UPDATE statement. It needs at least one assignment before the WHERE clause can be added.

      • usingTtl

        @NonNull
UpdateStart usingTtl​(int ttlInSeconds)
        Adds a USING TTL clause to this statement with a literal value. Setting a value of null will remove the USING TTL clause on this statement. Setting a value of 0 will update the data and remove any TTL on the column when the statement is executed, overriding any TTL (table or column) that may exist in Cassandra.

        If this method or usingTtl(BindMarker) is called multiple times, the value from the last invocation is used.

        Parameters:
        ttlInSeconds - Time, in seconds, the inserted data should live before expiring.

      • usingTtl

        @NonNull
UpdateStart usingTtl​(@NonNull
                     BindMarker bindMarker)
        Adds a USING TTL clause to this statement with a bind marker. Setting a value of null will remove the USING TTL clause on this statement. Binding a value of 0 will update the data and remove any TTL on the column when the statement is executed, overriding any TTL (table or column) that may exist in Cassandra.

        If this method or usingTtl(int) is called multiple times, the value from the last invocation is used.

        Parameters:
        bindMarker - A bind marker that is understood to be a value in seconds.

        timeout - A timeout value controlling server-side query timeout.
